title: Layer product count recurrence
statement: For all natural numbers $a,s,c$, the layer product with parameters $(a,s+1,c+1)$ equals $\bigl(2c-2a+1\bigr)$ times the layer product with parameters $(a,s,c)$; here the layer product at $(a,k,c)$ is $\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}\bigl(2c-2(a+j)-1\bigr)$.
